products.title: Classic Cassette Boombox
products.body_html:
A big, bold stereo boombox with twin speakers, a front-loading tape deck and a telescopic antenna. The Analog Attic Classic Cassette Boombox is the loudest, proudest piece on the shelf.

Key Features

  • Twin full-range speakers behind metal grilles
  • Cassette deck with chunky transport buttons
  • Telescopic antenna and a commanding stereo presence
  • Pre-loved character: period stickers and light scuffing on the casing

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Analog Attic
  • Configuration: Single boombox
  • Colour: Gunmetal grey
  • Dimensions: Width: approximately 72 cm; depth: approximately 19 cm; height: approximately 47 cm with antenna extended
  • Materials: Moulded plastic casing, metal speaker grilles and antenna

Care Instructions

Dust with a soft, dry cloth. Keep away from damp, direct heat and strong sunlight, and never use solvent cleaners on dials, labels or lenses.

What's Included

1 boombox; batteries and cassette tapes not included

Placement & Usage Notes

A heavy piece, so place it on a sturdy shelf or sideboard. The stickers are part of its history, so please do not peel them. Collectible vintage-style electronics: use a surge protector with any plug-in power.

Dust with a soft, dry cloth. Keep away from damp, direct heat and strong sunlight, and never use solvent cleaners on dials, labels or lenses.

products.title: Rangefinder Film Camera
products.body_html:
A compact, all-business rangefinder with a leather-look body and a proper neck strap. The Analog Attic Rangefinder Film Camera is built for slow, deliberate pictures.

Key Features

  • Compact body with a leatherette grip finish
  • Manual dials for shutter speed and exposure
  • Genuine-feeling leather neck strap included

Product Specifications

  • Brand: Analog Attic
  • Configuration: Camera body with fixed lens and strap
  • Colour: Black / Chrome
  • Dimensions: Width: approximately 15 cm; depth: approximately 9 cm; height: approximately 8 cm
  • Materials: Metal-look body, leatherette trim, leather strap

Care Instructions

Keep the lens cap on when not in use and wipe the body with a soft, dry cloth. Clean the lens only with a proper lens brush and cloth.

What's Included

1 camera body with lens, 1 neck strap; film not included

Placement & Usage Notes

Sold as a display and collectible piece. Keep dry, store in a padded case and avoid leaving it in direct sunlight.
